description: This class includes the manufacture of hydraulic and pneumatic components and systems.
includes: manufacture of hydraulic and pneumatic equipment: hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic and pneumatic actuators, hydraulic pumps, hydraulic and pneumatic valves, hydraulic and pneumatic hose assemblies
manufacture of air preparation equipment for pneumatic systems
excludes: manufacture of pumps for liquids, see 2813
manufacture of valves for non-fluid power use, see 2813
